answer.reason: The verses state several major deeds of Nebuchadnezzar: besieging and destroying Jerusalem, carrying Judah captive, making the golden image, and being humbled to eat grass like oxen.

clauses.english: besieged Jerusalem and carried Jehoiachin and its mighty men captive to Babylon
clauses.quote: the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign

clauses.english: set Zedekiah on the throne, and later destroyed Jerusalem and its temple
clauses.quote: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem

clauses.english: made a golden image and had Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego cast into the fiery furnace
clauses.quote: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold

clauses.english: was driven from men to eat grass like oxen, until he praised the most High
clauses.quote: he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen

doubts: JER 46:2 gives his defeat of Pharaoh Necho at Carchemish, left out to keep the line short.
Dream and Daniel's interpretation (DAN 2) left out as its main verses are context, not marked, though DAN 2:46-48 could also be a clause.
